scene: The terminal boots, unlocking three transport gates across the yard.
picture: A flat side-view yard. Far left, a sleek glass elevator awaits open. Left, the girl in her purple wheelchair sits by the glowing terminal. Centre, a ladder leads up high to a moored brass airship basket. Right, a colourful miniature steam train idles along tracks. Far right, the repair yard wall shows flashing maps.
shown: a sleek glass elevator with open doors on the far left
a colourful miniature steam train puffing sweet vapour on the right
a moored brass airship basket with an open hatch up high
